opportunities.title: Junior Scientist Conference Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Scheme (A) open to undergraduate, Master’s and PhD student members and postdoctoral members within six years of PhD viva; Schemes (B) & (C) open to PhD student and postdoctoral members within six years of PhD viva; UK‑based members for conferences outside the UK and non‑UK members for UK conferences.
opportunities.summary: Supports attendance of Genetics Society junior scientist members at conferences (including Society meetings, non‑Society meetings and virtual conferences).

opportunities.title: Training Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All members of the Genetics Society who are studying or working in the UK (students must be Society members; others need at least one year membership).
opportunities.summary: Grants up to £1,200 to enable members to attend short training courses or collaborative visits for genetics/genomic techniques.

opportunities.title: Heredity Fieldwork Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All members of the Genetics Society studying or working in the UK, or intending to conduct fieldwork in the UK.
opportunities.summary: Awards up to £2,000 to cover travel and accommodation for field‑based genetic research projects.

opportunities.title: One-off Meeting Grant

amount.raw: several hundred pounds up to several thousand pounds (typical £1,000–£2,000)

opportunities.summary: Sponsorship for genetics‑themed meetings not organised directly by the Society, including support for Carer’s Awards.

opportunities.title: Public Engagement Grant
opportunities.summary: Grants up to £1,000 to support public engagement activities related to genetics, covering travel and materials costs.
